author: PokerFace
body:
Hello everyone! I hope you had a nice holiday! Anyways, you know how those spammy posts or short questions always get locked? Why not just archive it? If the staff do have the proper authority, just archive it. When they are locked, the post doesn't move, it just forbids replies. By cleaning up the forums a bit, you could navigate easier and maybe the website could be faster than it already is not having to load thousands of posts. If staff however cannot, implement it or, archive your own posts when resolved or whatevers. The forums is a big place so maybe choose a select few to help out. Thanks for listening!
-PokerFace_Legend

replies.author: Bluecichlid
replies.body:
1) I don’t see the point of a "forum clear up", old posts sink to the bottom anyway so it’s not like they are clogging up the current posts.

2) “Maybe the website could be faster than it already is not having to load thousands of posts”. From what I know, archiving threads does not actually delete them, they are just stored out of sight from the user. This means the speed of the website server should still be the same due to the fact that the same amount of posts are still being stored.

3) Some old threads may be relevant in the future or might be helpful to players searching the forums. Deleting these threads would mean more threads would be created to address the same or similar topic.

Just my opinion, have a nice day!
